title_cn: 客户事实陈述与声明书
case_lines: Peiyun Zhou and Jian Wang  ·  Dog bite of August 17, 2026
9058 Westhill Rd., Lakeside, California 92040  ·  County of San Diego  ·  Activity No. A26-677072
timeline: I scanned and loaded my packages for that day's SwiftX route.
我扫码装货，准备当天 SwiftX 的配送路线。
We left on the route. My husband, Jian Wang, was driving.
我们出发送货。我先生王坚开车。
I completed the first delivery of the day.
我完成当天第一单。
I completed seventy-four deliveries over the course of the morning.
整个上午我陆续完成七十四单。

**Stop 262, the seventy-fifth delivery — 9058 Westhill Rd.** I walked down to the residence with the package in my left hand and my telephone in my right hand. I set the package on the ground outside the door, at the iron gate, and took the delivery photograph. My telephone records that photograph as August 17, 2026 at 12:24 p.m.
**第 262 站、当天第 75 单 —— 9058 Westhill Rd.** 我左手拿包裹、右手拿手机走到住宅前，把包裹放在门外地上、铁门门口，拍摄送达照片。我的手机记录该照片的拍摄时间为 2026 年 8 月 17 日 12:24 p.m.。
Two dogs, dark brown to black and of medium to large size, came down the stairs at speed. Both knocked me to the ground. I landed with my right side upward, and they bit me repeatedly.
两只深棕至黑色、中到大型的狗从楼梯上快速冲下，合力将我扑倒。我倒地时右半身朝上，两只狗反复撕咬我。
My husband was sitting in the vehicle with the window open. He heard me calling his name and shouting that the dogs were biting me. He reached me and found both dogs on top of me.
我先生当时坐在车内、车窗开着。他听到我喊他的名字、喊「狗咬」。他跑到我身边，看到两只狗都压在我身上。

He picked up a white folding chair lying nearby and struck one dog. That dog turned and bit him. He did not stop; he kept striking the second dog, which was still biting me, until both were off me. Both dogs then turned on him.
他就近拿起一把白色折叠椅击打其中一只狗，那只狗转过来咬他。他没有停手，继续击打仍在咬我的另一只狗，直到两只狗都离开我身上，随后两只狗转而攻击他。
I got up. Three workers in yellow vests heard the shouting, came with wooden sticks and tools, and drove the dogs away.
我爬起身。附近三名穿黄色马甲的工人闻声赶来，手持木棍和工具把狗驱开。
We ran uphill toward our vehicle. One of my shoes was bitten off as we fled.
我们往坡上朝车跑。逃跑时我的一只鞋被狗咬掉。
**At the top of the slope my husband recorded a video of me.** The telephone records that video as August 17, 2026 at 12:29 p.m.
**跑上坡后我先生拍摄了一段我的视频。**手机记录该视频的拍摄时间为 2026 年 8 月 17 日 12:29 p.m.。
One dog followed us up the slope, crossed to the far side of the road, then turned and ran back toward our vehicle. We got in and drove away.
其中一只狗追上坡，跑到马路另一侧，随后又折返朝我们的车跑来。我们上车驶离。
We arrived at the nearest family doctor's office. It did not open until 1:00 p.m.
我们抵达最近的家庭医生诊所。诊所下午一点才开门。
Weiwei Xue, my husband's aunt, drove to the doctor's office.
我先生的姑姑薛薇薇驱车赶到诊所门口。

She called 911 for us. Neither my husband nor I speaks English, and every call to every agency in this matter was made by her on our behalf. Because we had already left the scene, the police told us to contact animal control instead.
她替我们拨打 911。我和我先生都不会英文，本案与各机关之间的每一通电话都由她代打。因我们已离开现场，警方告知改为联系动物管理部门。
An ambulance arrived for me.
救护车抵达，接我。
The ambulance left for the hospital. My husband went to the emergency room in Weiwei Xue's vehicle. We were both treated there.
救护车出发前往医院。我先生搭薛薇薇的车前往急诊。我们两人均在急诊接受治疗。
Animal Services became involved after a social worker at the hospital contacted the Department.
后来是医院的社工联系了动物管理部门，该部门才介入。
narrative: On the morning of August 17, 2026 I scanned and loaded my packages at 6:30 a.m. for that day's SwiftX delivery route. We left at about 8:00 a.m. and I completed my first delivery at 8:41 a.m. My husband, Jian Wang, was driving. We have worked as a pair since I began delivering for SwiftX on February 11, 2026: I make the deliveries and he drives. He is not engaged by SwiftX and receives no pay for driving.
2026 年 8 月 17 日早上 6 点 30 分，我扫码装货，准备当天 SwiftX 的配送路线。大约 8 点出发，8 点 41 分完成当天第一单。那天是我先生王坚开车。自我 2026 年 2 月 11 日开始为 SwiftX 送货起，我们两人就是搭档：我送货，他开车。他和 SwiftX 之间没有雇佣或承揽关系，也不会因为开车拿到任何报酬。

By midday I had completed seventy-four deliveries. The seventy-fifth was stop 262, 9058 Westhill Rd., Lakeside, California. The delivery guidance in the SwiftX application carried no gate or access information for that address. I walked down to the residence carrying the package in my left hand and my telephone in my right hand. I set the package down on the ground outside the door, at the iron gate, and took the delivery photograph that SwiftX requires. My telephone records that photograph as August 17, 2026 at 12:24 p.m.
到中午的时候，我已经送完七十四单。第七十五单就是第 262 站，9058 Westhill Rd., Lakeside。SwiftX 的派送引导上没有任何门禁信息。我左手拿着包裹、右手拿着手机走到住宅门口，把包裹放在门外地上、铁门门口，然后按 SwiftX 的要求拍了送达照片。我的手机记录那张照片的拍摄时间是 2026 年 8 月 17 日 12 点 24 分。

As I finished the delivery, two dogs came down the stairs at speed. They were dark brown to black and of medium to large size. The two dogs knocked me to the ground together. I landed with my right side upward, and they bit me repeatedly while I was down.
就在我完成送达的时候，两只狗从楼梯上快速冲了下来。那两只狗是深棕到黑色的，中到大型。两只狗一起把我扑倒在地。我倒下去的时候右半身朝上，它们就在我倒地的时候反复咬我。

My husband was sitting in the vehicle with the window open. He heard me calling his name and shouting that the dogs were biting me. He ran to me and found both dogs on top of me. He picked up a white folding chair that was lying nearby and struck one of the dogs. That dog turned and bit him. He did not stop to attend to himself. He kept striking the second dog, which was still biting me, until he had driven both dogs off me. Both dogs then turned on him and bit him.
我先生王坚当时坐在车里，车窗是开着的。他听到我喊他的名字，喊「狗咬、狗咬」。他跑过来，看到两只狗都压在我身上。他就近拿起一把白色的折叠椅，打其中一只狗。那只狗转过来咬了他。他没有顾自己，继续打另外一只狗 —— 因为那只狗还在咬我。他把两只狗都从我身上打开以后，两只狗就转过来咬他。

I got up off the ground. Three workers wearing yellow vests had heard the shouting and came over carrying wooden sticks and tools, and they drove the dogs away. My husband and I then ran uphill toward our vehicle. One of my shoes was bitten off as we fled. When we reached the top of the slope, my husband recorded a video of me; the telephone records that video as August 17, 2026 at 12:29 p.m. One of the dogs followed us up the slope, crossed to the far side of the road, and then turned and ran back toward our vehicle. We got in and drove away.
我从地上爬起来。附近三名穿黄色马甲的工人听到我们的喊声跑过来，手里拿着木棍和工具，把狗打开。我和先生赶紧往坡上朝车的方向跑。逃的时候，我的一只鞋被狗咬掉了。跑上坡以后，我先生拍了一段我的视频，手机记录那段视频的拍摄时间是 2026 年 8 月 17 日 12 点 29 分。其中一只狗追上坡来，跑到马路的另一边，然后又折返朝我们的车跑过来。我们上了车，开车离开。

We drove to the nearest family doctor's office and arrived at 12:47 p.m., but the office did not open until 1:00 p.m. My husband's aunt, Weiwei Xue, drove to the doctor's office and arrived at about 12:55 p.m. Neither my husband nor I speaks English, and every call to every agency in this matter was placed by her on our behalf. She called 911. Because we had already left the scene, the police told us to contact animal control rather than sending an officer.
我们开车去了最近的家庭医生诊所，12 点 47 分到，但诊所要下午一点才开门。我先生的姑姑薛薇薇开车赶到诊所门口，大概 12 点 55 分到。我和我先生都不会英文，这件事里所有打给各个机关的电话，都是姑姑替我们打的。她替我们打了 911。因为我们已经离开现场，警察让我们改为联系动物管理部门。

An ambulance arrived for me at 1:18 p.m. and left for the hospital at 1:26 p.m. My husband went to the emergency room in Weiwei Xue's vehicle. We were both treated in the emergency room. Animal Services became involved after a social worker at the hospital contacted the Department.
下午 1 点 18 分救护车到了，接我；1 点 26 分救护车出发去医院。我先生坐姑姑的车去急诊。我们两个人最后都在急诊接受了治疗。后来是医院的社工联系了动物管理部门，该部门才介入。

declarants.body_en: I, Peiyun Zhou, declare: the statement set out above has been read and translated to me in Mandarin Chinese, and I have read the Chinese text myself. The facts stated in it are within my own personal knowledge and are true and correct. If any part of it is later found to be inaccurate, I will tell my attorneys so that it can be corrected.
declarants.body_cn: 本人周培云声明：以上陈述已由他人以普通话向本人宣读并翻译，本人亦已自行阅读中文文本。其中所载事实均为本人亲身知悉，且真实无误。日后如发现其中任何部分与事实不符，本人将立即告知代理律师，以便更正。

declarants.body_en: I, Jian Wang, declare: the statement set out above has been read and translated to me in Mandarin Chinese, and I have read the Chinese text myself. The facts stated in it that concern me are within my own personal knowledge and are true and correct. In particular, I was driving on August 17, 2026; I went to my wife's aid when the dogs attacked her; both dogs bit me; and I am the person who recorded the video of my wife at the top of the slope.
declarants.body_cn: 本人王坚声明：以上陈述已由他人以普通话向本人宣读并翻译，本人亦已自行阅读中文文本。其中涉及本人的事实均为本人亲身知悉，且真实无误。尤其是：2026 年 8 月 17 日当天由本人开车；两只狗攻击我太太时，是本人上前施救；两只狗亦咬伤本人；坡上那段我太太的视频，系本人所拍摄。
